resale_co.how_to_apply: No Township resale Certificate of Occupancy. The Township says the only inspection needed to sell a house is the Fire Prevention smoke detector inspection (smoke alarms, CO alarms and kitchen fire extinguisher). Open permits should be closed before transfer.

evidence.quote: The only inspection required to sell your house is a Smoke Detector Inspection , which also includes carbon monoxide detectors and a fire extinguisher in the kitchen.
BEFORE YOU CLOSE: All open permits should be closed out before you transfer your property.

resale_co.notes: The Township's Selling Your House page (Construction Department) says the smoke detector inspection is the only inspection required to sell a house. The Fire Prevention form is titled "Application For CCO Inspections", but it is the smoke/CO certificate, not a building resale CO.

requirements: Smoke alarm on each level including basements (not attic or crawl space) and outside each separate sleeping area within 10 feet of bedrooms

10-year sealed battery smoke alarms (ANSI/UL 217) where battery alarms are used; AC alarms from construction or rehabilitation cannot be replaced with battery alarms, and AC alarms more than 10 years old must be replaced before the inspection
CO alarm in the immediate vicinity of sleeping areas (UL 2034, NFPA 720) unless the home has no fuel-burning device or attached garage
Low-voltage alarm systems: monitoring contact, account and password, plus certification from an alarm technician
Portable fire extinguisher 2A-10B:C, no more than 10 pounds, serviced and tagged within 12 months or with a recent purchase receipt; owner's manual left for the new occupant (form still lists it)
Secondary power source label ("Caution: Multiple Sources Of Power") within 18 inches of the main panel and the meter, if the home has a generator, solar panels or battery storage

authorities.how_to_apply: Fill out the Application For CCO Inspections (Form Center, Fire Prevention) and email it to fireprevention@denvillenj.org or drop it off or mail it to Denville Town Hall, 1 St. Mary's Place. Checks payable to Denville Township Fire Prevention. To schedule call (973) 625-8300 ext. 257.

*Please send completed application to fireprevention@denvillenj.org or drop off in person
*Please ensure checks are made payable to Denville Township Fire Prevention*

Before any one and two family or attached single family structure is sold, leased or otherwise made subject to a change of occupancy for residential purposes, the owner shall obtain a certificate of smoke alarm, carbon monoxide alarm, and portable fire extinguisher compliance
LEAID: 1408-001 Denville Twp ... Enf Auth. Fire Dept ... Fire Official Connor Mc Guinness Phone (973) 625-8300 ... Email fireprevention@denvillenj.org

fire_cert.notes: Fees match on the application and the Township fee schedule page. The Township page names Fire Official Carmine Ruta; the state directory (survey 3/27/2026) lists Connor Mc Guinness. The Form Center also posts a notarized Smoke/CO/Fire Extinguisher Affidavit with the CCO packet; when it is accepted is not explained. The requirements still list the portable fire extinguisher, which state law (P.L.2025, c.19) removed from the sale certificate in February 2025; confirm with the Bureau.

open_questions: Does Denville still require the kitchen fire extinguisher after P.L.2025, c.19?
When is the notarized Smoke/CO/Fire Extinguisher Affidavit used instead of, or in addition to, the inspection?
Is there a reinspection fee? None is published.
